scientific_integrity: Self-review of the Poisson phase theorem; finite verifier corroboration is not an infinite proof. Publication priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Finite commutative local algebras only; base algebra generation is as a unital F_q-algebra.
The asymptotic fixes residue degree f, generator count k, tangent dimension d, and c while q grows.
The complete exact generator criterion follows from prior algebraic work; the assessed result is the independent three-obstruction Poisson phase diagram.
No optimal convergence rate or noncommutative extension is established.
title: Triple-Poisson birthday transition for random generators of finite local-algebra powers
